notes.title: Character orientation correction
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the character would face a certain direction when the left stick was released.

notes.title: Player control issue improvement
notes.notes:
Thank you for supporting Conceptual Cage.
I am truly sorry that the player controls remained poor for so long.
With this update, the player controls have been improved.
I think this has made the game much easier to play.
I hope you will continue to support Conceptual Cage's games.
